answer_1.quote: We designed two types of tasks: (1) Scrambled Sentence Recovery, which tests the capability of LLMs to reconstruct the original sentences from scrambled ones, and (2) Scrambled Question Answering, which measures how well LLMs can answer questions when some context is scrambled.
answer_1.outputs: Recovered sentences and answers to questions
